id_routing.description: Interconnect may append bits to AxID to identify the originating master; slave-side ID_WIDTH > master-side ID_WIDTH
id_routing.compliance_note: Returning ID is the WIDER value; routing strips appended bits before returning to the master

fields.topology_type: Host-to-memory bus: a host controller (master) drives the shared CK/CK#, DQ[7:0], and RWDS, with one CS# per HyperBus device (slave). Devices are selected by their individual CS#; HyperRAM and HyperFlash share the same pin-out and may coexist on the bus.

supported_topologies.name: Multi-device shared bus
supported_topologies.description: Several devices share CK/DQ/RWDS, each with its own CS#.

supported_topologies.name: Mixed HyperRAM + HyperFlash
supported_topologies.description: RAM and flash on the same bus (shared pin-out / footprint).

master_slave_role_summary.description: Drives CK/CK#, CS#, the CA, and write data/RWDS-mask; captures read data using RWDS.
HyperRAM or HyperFlash; responds to its CS#; drives read data + RWDS strobe and the variable-latency RWDS indication.

fields.interconnect_role: HyperBus is a host-to-memory interface: the host originates every transaction (CA + latency + data) and the selected device responds. There is no peer arbitration — the host owns the bus and selects one device at a time via CS#.

ordering_guarantees.transaction_order: Transactions are issued one at a time by the host, framed by CS#.
ordering_guarantees.burst_order: Wrapped bursts wrap within the configured length; linear bursts increment until CS# deasserts.

fields.memory_vs_peripheral_regions: HyperBus addresses a memory array (Address Space=0; row+upper-column in CA[44:16], lower-column byte in CA[2:0]) and a register space (Address Space=1; ID0/ID1, CR0/CR1).

device_classification.hyperram: Self-refresh pseudo-static RAM (DRAM core, SRAM-like interface, distributed refresh, deep power down).
device_classification.hyperflash: NOR flash on the identical HyperBus interface; program/erase via NOR command sequences.
device_classification.host_controller: Master that drives CK/CS#/CA/RWDS and the DDR PHY.

default_signal_values_evidence_tables: HyperBus signal list (CK/CK#, CS#, DQ[7:0], RWDS, RESET#, INT#)
